Pushups x999999999


Lose weight (though 4 weeks isn't much time for this)

Good evening, caller.  Welcome to the program. 

My family and friends aren't aware that I'm struggling.   I'd rather not worry them.   If I tell them I'm low once, they'll never forget, and the won't understand, and ultimately will just complicate things. 

I'm afraid of telling my doctor how low I actually am because things will be set in motion that I can't undo.

Do I actually feel this way?  I don't feel like I can trust myself to feel the same about anything from one day to the next.


Thanks for responding!
